sourceConflict.title: Error Type 19 differs by section in Version 6 Manual Operation

userDirective.text: Application44ERROR is renumbered to No.24 in this application; No.19 remains Prohibited substance(Benzene).

sourceConflict.details: Section II System Data Confirm & Judge flow lists No.19 as Prohibited substance(Benzene), while Appendix I (Judgment procedure and criteria) lists No.19 as Application44ERROR. These are preserved as separate source entries; the application must not silently merge or choose one. Benzene is also shown as a substance-specific No.14 flow in Manual Flow.
